## Setup

```{r, message=FALSE}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
source(here("R", "99_proj_func.R"))

# Folder for saved plots
dir.create(here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load data

We load the augmented dataset from the previous step. We use
`mutation_category` to group mutations by where they are in the complex.

```{r, message=FALSE}
dat_aug <- read_csv(
  here("data", "03_dat_aug.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    mutation_category = col_factor(
      levels = c("ab_heavy", "ab_light", "antigen")
      )))
```

## Dataset overview

We first count the number of experimental $\Delta \Delta G$ measurements, unique
variants, and complexes. We count measurements and variants separately
because the same variant can be measured more than once. All rows are
single-point mutations, because 02_clean removed multiple mutations,
insertions and deletions. 

```{r}
dat_aug |>
  summarise(
    n_measurements = n(),
    n_variants = n_distinct(pdb, mut_chain, mut_position, mut_from, mut_to),
    n_complexes = n_distinct(pdb),
  )
```

For single-point measurements, we show the number and percentage on
the antibody heavy chain, antibody light chain, and antigen. If some
measurements have no chain category, we include them as `Unknown` and
keep them in the total used to calculate the percentages.

```{r}
dat_aug |>
  mutate(mutation_category = fct_na_value_to_level(mutation_category,
                                                   level = "Unknown")) |>
  count(mutation_category) |>
  mutate(percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
```

## Mutations to alanine vs. other amino acids

We compare single-point mutations to alanine with mutations to any other
amino acid. The first panel shows the experimental $\Delta \Delta G$, followed by one
panel for each computational method. We use the same set of variants
across panels where possible and show the number of measurements in each
group so we can see when the available data differ between panels.

We add a small boxplot inside each violin and a dashed line at $\Delta \Delta G = 0$.
All groups have more than 200 measurements, so we do not need to show
individual points.

```{r}
#| label: fig-04-alanine-vs-other
#| fig-cap: "Experimental and predicted ΔΔG for mutations to alanine vs. other amino acids. Saved as results/04_plot_alanine_vs_other.png."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
# Keep only variants that have a prediction from every method,
# so all panels show the same set of variants
ddg_long <- dat_aug |>
  drop_na(ends_with("_ddg")) |>
  select(pdb, mut_chain, mut_position, mut_from, mut_to, to_alanine,
         experimental = ddg, ends_with("_ddg")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(experimental, ends_with("_ddg")),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "ddg"
  ) |>
  drop_na(ddg) |>
  mutate(
    method = str_remove(method, "_ddg"),
    method = fct_relevel(method, "experimental")
  ) |>
  add_target_label()

plot_alanine_vs_other <- ddg_long |>
  plot_ddg_violin(
    facet_var = "method",
    y_label = "ΔΔG (kcal/mol)",
    title = "ΔΔG for mutations to alanine vs. other amino acids",
    free_y = TRUE
  )

plot_alanine_vs_other

ggsave(
  filename = here("results", "04_plot_alanine_vs_other.png"),
  plot = plot_alanine_vs_other,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Experimental ΔΔG by chain

We repeat the alanine comparison using experimental $\Delta \Delta G$ only, with
separate panels for the heavy chain, light chain, and antigen. Each
panel shows the distributions for mutations to alanine and mutations
to other amino acids. We use the same $\Delta \Delta G$ scale across panels so we can
compare the distributions between chains.

```{r}
#| label: fig-04-ddg-by-chain
#| fig-cap: "Experimental ΔΔG by chain for mutations to alanine vs. other amino acids. Saved as results/04_plot_ddg_by_chain.png."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
plot_ddg_by_chain <- dat_aug |>
  add_target_label() |>
  plot_ddg_violin(
    facet_var = "mutation_category",
    y_label = "Experimental ΔΔG (kcal/mol)",
    title = "Experimental ΔΔG by chain"
  )

plot_ddg_by_chain

ggsave(
  filename = here("results", "04_plot_ddg_by_chain.png"),
  plot = plot_ddg_by_chain,
  width = 9,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```
